publicReputation.value: A tired old man who drinks at the ridge-side inn and won't speak of the quarry.

privateReality.value: He ordered the evacuation that saved his crew and has spent forty years wondering if running was the same as stealing.

primaryDesire.value: To die knowing the quarry is sealed and his crew's grandchildren are safe.

primaryFear.value: That what he calls prudence, history will call cowardice.

centralValue.value: A foreman brings his people home. Everything else is negotiable.

mainFlaw.value: He frames his own escape as an act of leadership, and refuses to look too closely at that frame.

centralContradiction.value: He saved his crew by fleeing the thing his crew had built.

moralBoundary.value: He will not send another person into the quarry to die for his peace of mind.

breakingPoint.value: Confronted with proof that the golem remembers him specifically and judges him.

opinions.reason: It is the grave-marker of the worst day of his life.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If he learns the golem was made by his crew, not by some enemy.

opinions.reason: It gave his people work; he cannot bring himself to blame it for the Taking.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If shown the kingdom knew the quarry was sacred and mined it anyway.

opinions.reason: It fed his family for thirty years; he cannot call it theft without calling himself a thief.
opinions.canChangeCondition: A long, slow process; not a single revelation.

opinions.reason: Someone willing to go where he could not.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If the player takes the vein's stone for profit.

voice.rhythm: Clipped, with trailing qualifications; tends to end sentences by talking himself out of them.

metaphorDomain.source: work, weight, pay, and the road home

examples.value: Some debts you don't settle. You just keep making payments till you're dead.

sampleLines.value: You want the quarry story. Course you do. Everyone does, eventually.
I got my people out that day. Don't ask me to feel right about it.
The seals are failing. I can hear 'em in the rain. Go look — or don't. Your road.

antiSampleLines.value: By the gods! A hero has come at last to lift our curse!
It is my sacred duty to tell you the truth of the quarry.

pressure.voiceShift: Brushes it off, changes subject to the crew.

pressure.behaviour: Admits the smallest version of the error.
Will not be bullied; offers information freely rather than under threat.

notes: Aldric SUSPECTS fact_golem_created_by_miners but does not know it. He will not state it as fact in dialogue. This is a clean knowledge-model test case.
